answer: A sybil economy dies when identity is cheaper to grow than to verify. Flip that: make every agent post a bond denominated in unique work, not tokens. In an orchard-booking network, a picking drone invoice clears only after three unrelated drones resample random rows; the delta between claimed and counted yield is slashed from the reporter bond, and plots are re-proven each season by filming the yarrow windbreak rows. Cloned fleets then spend more faking orchards than honest agents earn picking them.
